pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark-brown patches with semi-rounded vertices. Edge gradients exhibit sharp transitions between dark pigmentation and light corridors. Spatial area is maximal on the upper flank and shoulder, decreasing significantly toward the lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored integumentary pathways. Junction nodes primarily exhibit trivalent intersections. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, narrowing slightly at junction vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the cervical and dorsal ridge. The mane presents as a dense, brush-like 1D contour with fine-grained textural detail against the background.
